title: Lion cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M78 78 Q92 76 90 62' stroke='#f2b134' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='62' r='5' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='55' cy='72' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f2b134'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='55' cy='79' rx='15' ry='8' fill='#ffe08a'/>
    <!-- front legs -->
    <rect x='42' y='82' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#f2b134'/>
    <rect x='58' y='82' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#f2b134'/>
    <ellipse cx='46.5' cy='94' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e09b23'/>
    <ellipse cx='62.5' cy='94' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e09b23'/>
    <!-- mane -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='24' fill='#c9781f'/>
    <g fill='#b5651a'>
      <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='16' cy='22' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='17' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='44' cy='20' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='49' cy='36' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='57' r='6'/>
      <circle cx='15' cy='53' r='6'/>
    </g>
    <!-- face -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='18' fill='#ffe08a'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='17' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f2b134'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='24' r='6' fill='#f2b134'/>
    <circle cx='17' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='23' cy='38' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#3a2a10'/>
    <ellipse cx='37' cy='38' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#3a2a10'/>
    <circle cx='24.5' cy='36.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='38.5' cy='36.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#fff3c4'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <path d='M26 45 Q30 42 34 45 Q32 48 30 48 Q28 48 26 45 Z' fill='#b5651a'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M30 48 Q30 51 27 51 M30 48 Q30 51 33 51' stroke='#8a5a10' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- whisker dots -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a10'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='50' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a10'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a10'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a10'/>
    <!-- eyebrow tufts -->
    <path d='M18 32 Q21 30 24 32' stroke='#b5651a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M36 32 Q39 30 42 32' stroke='#b5651a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
